policy: Evidence inventory, not a percentage of full language implementation. Candidate files require rule-specific review.

rules.decision_summary: Indentation blocks with colon; no required braces or semicolons.
Immutable bindings by default; var mutable; const compile-time; optional type annotations.
Lists, maps, sets, records with concise literals.
Dart operators plus and/or/not and null-aware operators.
if/else-if/else statements and expressions.
for-in, ranges inclusive/exclusive, step, while, break/continue, await-for.
Typed function declarations and expression-bodied functions.
Classes with fields and generated constructors.
known_limits: Parent constructor synthesis still has an explicit E910 boundary.

rules.decision_summary: Parentheses-optional simple calls; named argument blocks; unified widget-like constructor calls.
async/async* and Future/Stream interoperability.
use imports and pub dependencies.
known_limits: Deferred imports need a prefix; prefix.loadLibrary() is covered for the tested library. Non-deferred loadLibrary is E300. Full import and export combinator certification remains open.

rules.decision_summary: try/catch/finally, throw, try-expression fallback, optional Result.
Dart null safety.
Static typing, inference, generics, aliases, explicit dynamic.
known_limits: Unknown foreign API metadata still has an unchecked dynamic fallback.

rules.decision_summary: Properties with get/set.
Public/private/protected visibility.
extends/implements/with and class modifiers.
Collection operations and comprehensions.
#, /* */, /// comments and annotations.
Interpolation "Hello {name}", escaped braces, raw/triple strings.
Compound assignments, no ++ or --.
Positional, named, optional, required parameters.
Single- and multi-line lambdas.
Generics.
known_limits: Some generic/native combinations remain explicitly rejected.

rules.decision_summary: Enums with fields and generated constructors.
init constructors, named, factory, const.
known_limits: Explicit parent constructors constrain synthesized child constructors.

rules.decision_summary: with object configuration, this/super, mixins.
using/using async deterministic cleanup.
match patterns.
await all and await isolate.
if let for nullable binding.
Explicit return in multiline functions and lambdas.
.quds modules and generated .dart files; pubspec compatibility.
Extensions and extension types (type ... wraps ...).
Interfaces, abstract classes and mixins.
Operator overloading with Dart-compatible fixed return constraints.
sync*/async*, yield/yield*.
Records and destructuring.
Expression-first and block-first comprehensions and spread.
Dart generic semantics.
known_limits: Raw generic superclasses and complex native signatures need more conformance.

rules.decision_summary: late immutable/mutable bindings.
static and class const.
Native Quds code generation targeting .quds.
Generated file management and optional part/part of.
Function types (Args) -> Return.
known_limits: Native values support explicit and concrete contextual specialization. Quds value adapters cover defaults, variadics, intersection parameters, zero-argument readonly result guards, generic extension values, and inherited static owners. Awkward parameter order, default-plus-variadic values, parameterized readonly result guards, method overloads, full constraint solving, and polymorphic callbacks remain limited.

Defaulted value slots are named optional, with a private omission token and sequential resolved defaults. Same-file function and concrete method bridges preserve repeated reference equality, including readonly proxies and selected-owner defaults. Unsupported provider-method/generic-interface/default-plus-intersection identity and complete direct-call parameter-form parity remain unfinished.

Supported top-level providers with declared signatures own their computed-default bridges, including direct calls and filtered re-exports. Unsupported provider methods, generic interfaces and nonportable signatures, SDK sections, awaiting defaults, inferred return metadata and expanded part/cycle/conditional-export certification remain separate work.

Public ordinary-class provider methods with supported declared signatures publish stable member bridges, including readonly proxies and null-aware default calls. Generic declaring interfaces, nonportable interface types, non-class/protected/private shapes and complex default signatures need separate certification.

The first interface member/resolver slice preserves defaults and equality for non-generic declaring interfaces with core/method-parameter signatures. Other interface source acceptance remains unchanged; generic owner binders, lexical type qualification and foreign implementors need separate certification.

rules.decision_summary: Callable classes via call.
with and with? replace Dart cascades.
assert (dev), require (input), check (state).
Typed catch, stack trace, rethrow, stack-aware throw.
value class with structural equality and immutable fields.
Auto copyWith for value classes; omitted differs from explicit null.
Record/list/map/object patterns.
defer sync/async, LIFO cleanup.
Safe inferred const and canonicalization.
factory and lazy isolate-local singleton class.
mixin/mixin class/on/with.
Dart class modifiers.
noSuchMethod under Dart constraints.
@Reflectable compile-time metadata generation compatible with AOT.
Native Quds compile-time macros with structured safe APIs.
annotation Name shorthand.
Conditional imports and compile-time when.
known_limits: Explicit VM/web/Flutter backend selection and conditional Quds imports are covered; live editor device-context certification remains open.

rules.decision_summary: quds create/add/remove/get/run/build/test/analyze/format CLI.
known_limits: Platform command transport is covered; native engine builds need CI evidence.

rules.decision_summary: test/group/expect and async/widget tests using Dart ecosystem.
known_limits: Real Flutter widget execution is a separate CI gate.

rules.decision_summary: Source-aware diagnostics, warnings, lint and fixes.
known_limits: Project-wide refactoring and quick-fix coverage are not complete.

rules.decision_summary: LSP, debug adapter, .quds breakpoints, Flutter hot reload.
known_limits: F5 save/update protocol is covered; engine state and breakpoint retention need real Flutter checks.

rules.decision_summary: /// docs, generated API docs, doctests.
Project language versions and migration.
Safe compiler optimization, performance/size benchmarks.
Dart FFI, JS interop, platform channels, binding generation.
known_limits: All FFI/JS interop and binding-generation shapes are not certified.

rules.decision_summary: Publish .quds and generated .dart to pub.dev.
known_limits: A stable package release and Quds/generated-Dart packaging gate remain required.

rules.decision_summary: Incremental compilation, caching, watch and hot reload.
known_limits: Quds save watching is covered; dependency/plugin changes require relaunch.

rules.decision_summary: Pub-based dependency resolution.
Deterministic formatter with project config.
known_limits: Formatting is deterministic in covered cases; complete project-format certification remains open.

rules.decision_summary: Runtime stack traces mapped back to Quds.
Structured logging with pluggable sinks.
Typed configuration with environment precedence and secrets.
Structured concurrency task group/spawn/cancellation.
Generic state/computed/watch reactive primitives.
Declarative if/for inside collection/children contexts; not Flutter-specific framework features.
Unified calls: positional+named arguments, nested calls, precise parsing.
`to Type` explicit conversion, `to? Type` safe conversion, `is`/`as` type tests and casts, explicit custom conversion protocol. `Type?` remains the nullable type.
Optional<T>, missing, present distinguish omission from explicit null.
Parameters non-reassignable by default; var parameter allows local reassignment only.
Static function overloading; deterministic compile-time resolution, reject ambiguity, unique Dart internal names.
known_limits: Local and imported function overload values use stable public names when signatures differ. Same-signature imports stay E204. Method overloads and awkward default or variadic value shapes remain unfinished.

rules.decision_summary: Computed defaults evaluated per call; may reference earlier parameters; distinguish omission and null.
Typed variadics ...values: Type, argument spreading and overload rules.
Record/list destructuring and parenthesized multi-assignment; evaluate RHS fully before mutation.
Named destructuring/aliasing for records, objects and maps with structure-specific syntax.
Lexical scope; explicit shadow keyword; outer mutable bindings can be assigned.
Dart-like closure capture; capture(...) snapshots bindings without deep copy.
readonly Type transitive through reference; static checking and runtime guard when needed.
known_limits: Some foreign final/sealed or erased readonly shapes intentionally report E910.

rules.decision_summary: Dart reference/alias semantics; optional static aliasing diagnostics; no mandatory Rust-style ownership.
Union types A | B with narrowing and safe Dart lowering.
Intersection types A & B for combined type contracts.
type aliases; wraps remains distinct extension type.
sealed type algebraic data types and match.
Exhaustiveness checking of match, strict for expressions.
Generic bounds including multiple constraints.
known_limits: Full foreign recursive bounds and raw generic inheritance are not certified.

rules.decision_summary: Safe declared in/out generic variance subject to Dart lowering constraints.
known_limits: Variance needs continued cross-feature/foreign boundary conformance.

rules.decision_summary: Contextual type inference; no unsafe implicit conversions or silent dynamic.
known_limits: The unresolved foreign API dynamic fallback is not a static safety guarantee.

rules.decision_summary: Preserve ?. ?? ??= safe operators.
Type wrapping with checked range/value invariants.
Generic extensions with bounds.
Pipeline |> with static resolution and deterministic evaluation.
do: expression blocks with explicit return.
Partial application using _ placeholders when type unambiguous.
Standard Result<T,E>, Ok/Error; exceptions remain supported.
Result propagation suffix ? with compatible error type.
Function contracts using require/check and result validation.
Left-to-right, exactly-once evaluation including defaults.
Deterministic name resolution; reject ambiguous symbols/extensions.
Type compatibility with no unsafe implicit conversions, union/generic/readonly checks.
known_limits: Readonly/foreign/generic boundary certification remains partial.

rules.decision_summary: Dart-facing API compatibility and explicit wrappers for Quds-only features.
known_limits: Generic native callbacks remain restricted; non-generic optional/named callback metadata has executable coverage.

rules.decision_summary: Uniform syntax and unambiguous parser for calls, properties, blocks.
